title: An undoable inspector
hints: An undo step stores the field and, for every affected object, its value before and after. Undo writes the befores, redo the afters, whatever is selected now.
`editValue` without a running edit can simply call `beginEdit`, write the value, and call `endEdit`.
requirements: A drag edits live and produces exactly one undo step.
Multi-selection edits every selected object that has the field, and undo restores each one's own value.
Edits that change nothing leave no undo step.
The document is clean exactly when it matches the last save.
stretch: Merge steps: when the same field of the same objects is changed again within one second, extend the previous step instead of adding a new one, as text editors do for typing.
